versions.content: A Dlt message, for which PduR_DltTransmit has been called, shall be removed from the LogChannel specific buffer in the following cases:  PduR_DltTransmit has returned with E_NOT_OK,  A positive TX confirmation for this TxPduId has been received, or  A negative TX confirmation for this TxPduId has been received and the transmit counter of the Dlt message is greater than the configured DltLogChannelMaxNumOfRetries.
